Name: Lava Is Water (By Wickedy)
Author: WickedyWoah
Description:
[b][size=5]What Is It:[/size][/b]

This mod is just a slight recolor of the volcano dungeon and on the caldera to change all lava to water, reusing and recoloring water sprites from the ocean and in Willy's boat room. Like, I can't promise it's any good, but here it is. (Monsters in the volcano dungeon have not been adjusted, just the red bits of the floors.)

[size=5][b]Installation: [/b][/size]

[size=3]1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI
[/url]2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
3. Install the mod (manual download is recommended over vortex)
4. Unzip the file, place the folder in your Mods folder
5. Launch your game and enjoy! [/size]
